summary: CP-006 local verification: 79 automated regression checks and 15 browser checks passed, with no failures or skipped checks. TypeScript validation passed. Worker production build passed; publication status is tracked separately by Sites.

browser.measurement: Time from successful commit response/read to detecting that version in the receiving browser. Same-host loopback, healthy connectivity; automatic updates without receiver reload. Suspension/recovery and second-worker writes included.

checks.title: Stale writes preserve their original edit base
checks.detail: REST 409 exposes current_workspace_version; browser recovery retains typed input, fetches the latest state, and requires deliberate reconciliation. Real D1 tests retain compare-and-update and atomic receipt guarantees.

checks.title: Quiet synchronization and recoverable save feedback
checks.detail: Browser verifies current, offline, reconnecting and action-required states; failed submissions remain open. Background refresh does not show an initial loading screen or a success toast. Compact 390px viewport has no horizontal overflow.

checks.title: Independent browser and MCP updates appear automatically
checks.detail: Separate browser contexts create, edit and delete requirements; MCP creates, stages and submits proposals and records evidence. Another browser applies the proposal. Receiving views update without reloading, preserve filters/focus, and retain frozen snapshot contents.

checks.title: Project-scoped monotonic reconciliation
checks.detail: Unit and browser tests cover version gaps, duplicates, older read/save responses, coalesced refreshes, late responses after switching projects and writes from a separate Worker process. Existing real-D1 regressions cover failed durable writes and idempotent replay across worker replacement.

checks.title: Protect pending edits, reviews and uncertain saves
checks.detail: Browser checks unrelated/conflicting changes, remote deletion, proposal submission during editing, open apply confirmation invalidation, and original-key retry after a lost successful metadata response. Input survives; confirmed retries create only one correction.

checks.title: Recover connectivity and avoid unchanged transfers
checks.detail: Browser exercises offline/online, injected 503 and denied access, actual Chromium page suspension/resume and unchanged 304 responses. Unit tests cover hidden tabs, opaque sign-in redirects, access cancellation, jitter and the 30-second retry cap. Hosted OAuth expiry/revocation is not certified by these simulations.

checks.title: Repeatable acceptance coverage against BL-006
checks.detail: The committed browser, API and unit tests and existing D1 regression suite provide the recorded outcomes against the seven exact requirement revisions listed here. No requirement lifecycle statuses are changed.

verification_scope: Implementation and local verification against Wonderworks BL-006 only. Hosted publication is independently confirmed by Sites deployment status. This report does not claim production latency or a hosted OAuth expiration/revocation exercise. Synchronization is read-only and CP-005 is not applied or edited.
